# Hi, I'm Leo Hung Nguyen

I'm a Boston-based analyst with an M.S. in Applied Business Analytics from Boston University. I'm interested in roles where I can investigate a business question, make the analysis reproducible, and explain what the evidence supports.

At **Crew Scaler**, I work on market research, program planning, and AI education. I bring the same habits to each: define the question first, keep a record of the evidence, and separate what we know from what we still need to test.
